inlines.v: RING'ENT, adjective [Latin ringor, to make wry faces, that is, to wring or twist.] In botany, a ringent or labiate corol is one which is irregular, monopetalous, with the border usually divided into two parts called the upper and lower lip; or irregular and gaping, like the mouth of an animal.
